messages.text: Holding out for Bitforfun Bs-1 stock. Any word?

No date yet — BitFortun is still off sale while they fix the firmware that misreported hashrate. Hardware was fine; the numbers weren't. Put yourself on the Notify me on that page.

If you'd rather not wait, the Hammer BC04 is 6 TH/s at $239 and ships from stock. Want me to check it for your region?
